value.title: Seven's Special Mission
value.synopsis: Seven embarks on a search for his long-lost memories — overcoming countless obstacles to awaken what's been sealed in the dark shadows.

value.title: Return to Xuanwu
value.synopsis: As the path to regaining his memories turns perilous, Seven faces Cheap-Life Hua — who hopes their battle will awaken his true self.

value.title: Acting Chairman of Chicken Island
value.synopsis: Redtooth ends Chicken Island's crisis and steps up as acting director — though fear from his colleagues leaves him stuck with menial work.

value.title: Thumbs-Up Showdown
value.synopsis: Consumed by vengeance, Ouyang Zan challenges Seven to a duel. Yet when Seven risks his life to save bystanders, guilt takes hold of him.

value.title: Nine-Fingered Deadful Melody
value.synopsis: After his sword duel, Seven and Dai Bo take refuge at an inn — where an encounter with the Nine-Fingered Deadful Melody helps them escape danger.

value.title: Bravely Barging Into Plum Blossom Mountain Villa
value.synopsis: With the Nine-Fingered Deadful Melody's help, Seven arrives at Plum Blossom Mountain Villa — uncovering echoes of a battle fought there days earlier.

value.title: Reunion
value.synopsis: At Plum Blossom Mountain Villa, Seven meets Plum Blossom Thirteen, who asks to be trained — but their lesson is interrupted by looming threats.

value.title: Prison Break
value.synopsis: Imprisoned with He DaChun, Seven tries to escape using the Thousand Demon Daggers — only to be recognized by an old enemy eager for rematch.

value.title: Eyeless Master's Prophecy
value.synopsis: At a graveyard from his memories, Seven learns the shocking truth about his past from the Eyeless Sorcerer — but fate takes an unexpected turn.

value.title: Battle of Black Rock Mountain
value.synopsis: Risking danger, Seven disguises himself as Plum Blossom Thirteen to rescue her master — walking into a fight that'll test his resolve.
